name: copilot-mesh.nvim
description: Neovim UI and process adapter for the Copilot Mesh multi-agent core

scripts.test: npm run test:adapter && npm run test:statusline && npm run test:agent-switch && nvim --headless -u NONE -l test/rename-compat.lua && nvim --headless -u NONE -l test/startup-picker.lua && nvim --headless -u NONE -l test/session-health.lua && nvim --headless -u NONE -l test/peer-steering.lua && python test/native_copilot_voice_test.py && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File scripts/run-visible-e2e.ps1
scripts.test:adapter: npm run build && node --test test/core-adapter.test.mjs test/rename-compat.test.mjs test/session-colors.test.mjs test/statusline-mcp.test.mjs
scripts.test:rename: npm run build && node --test test/rename-compat.test.mjs && nvim --headless -u NONE -l test/rename-compat.lua
scripts.test:session-health: npm run build && nvim --headless -u NONE -l test/session-health.lua
scripts.test:peer-steering: npm run build && nvim --headless -u NONE -l test/peer-steering.lua
scripts.test:e2e:observe: npm run build && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File scripts/run-visible-e2e.ps1 -Profile allow-all -Observe
scripts.test:e2e:allow-all: npm run build && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File scripts/run-visible-e2e.ps1 -Profile allow-all
scripts.test:e2e:allow-all-mcp: npm run build && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File scripts/run-visible-e2e.ps1 -Profile allow-all-mcp
scripts.test:e2e:manual-permissions: npm run build && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File scripts/run-visible-e2e.ps1 -Profile manual-permissions
scripts.test:e2e:telescope: npm run build && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File scripts/run-visible-e2e.ps1 -Profile telescope
